ink.note: Ramp is reference only; the system forbids greys. Intermediate tones are made by line frequency.

gallery.note: Ramp is reference only; the system forbids greys.

display.purpose: Product name, once per page; uppercase, balanced, max 9ch. Font from settings.type_display_font (big_shoulders_n8).

headline.purpose: Display-face statements such as lead-time weeks; dimension summary at 1.75rem.

title.purpose: Price in display face with tabular lining numerals.

body.purpose: Running text, max 65ch. Font from settings.type_body_font (schibsted_grotesk_n4); bold 700 for emphasis.

body-small.purpose: Detail text: arrival window, stage names, material and care, field labels.

label.purpose: Uppercase tracked label voice for nav, legends, figure captions, toggles and buttons (buttons 700).

lines.name: rule
lines.purpose: Every structural line: frames, dividers, borders, focus outlines, selected underlines.

lines.name: hatch
lines.purpose: End caps on buttons and fields.

lines.name: wave-stage
lines.purpose: Field behind the product canvas; merchant setting 6-24px.

lines.name: line-wide / line-medium / line-fine / line-ultra
lines.purpose: Declared in critical.css as the frequency ladder; not yet referenced by any component.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default easing for crossfades and small state changes.

motion.name: duration-slow
motion.purpose: Product image crossfade (opacity plus 6px blur on the leaving image).

motion.name: wave-pulse

components.css: :host{--ink:#000;--gallery:#fff;--rule:2px;--hatch:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,var(--ink) 0 2px,transparent 2px 5px);--ease-out:cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1);--duration-quick:180ms;font-family:'Schibsted Grotesk',sans-serif;color:var(--ink);background:var(--gallery);} .ds-btn{position:relative;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-height:3.5rem;padding:0 2.75rem 0 1rem;border:2px solid var(--ink);border-radius:0;background:var(--ink);color:var(--gallery);font:inherit;font-size:0.8125rem;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.14em;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 180ms linear,color 180ms linear;} .ds-btn::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset-block:0;inset-inline-end:0;width:1.75rem;border-inline-start:2px solid var(--gallery);background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,var(--gallery) 0 2px,transparent 2px 5px);} .ds-btn:hover{background:repeating-linear-gradient(0deg,var(--ink) 0 3px,var(--gallery) 3px 4px);} .ds-btn:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ink);outline-offset:3px;}

components.name: Outline Button

components.css: :host{--ink:#000;--gallery:#fff;--rule:2px;--hatch:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,var(--ink) 0 2px,transparent 2px 5px);--ease-out:cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1);--duration-quick:180ms;font-family:'Schibsted Grotesk',sans-serif;color:var(--ink);background:var(--gallery);} .ds-label{display:grid;gap:0.5rem;font-size:0.9375rem;} .ds-field{display:flex;align-items:stretch;border:2px solid var(--ink);} .ds-field input{flex:1;min-width:0;min-height:3rem;padding:0 1rem;border:0;border-radius:0;background:transparent;color:inherit;font:inherit;} .ds-field input:focus-visible{outline:none;} .ds-field:focus-within{outline:2px solid var(--ink);outline-offset:3px;} .ds-field__unit{display:flex;align-items:center;padding:0 0.75rem;border-inline-start:2px solid var(--ink);background:var(--hatch);font-size:0.8125rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.14em;} .ds-field__unit span{padding:0 0.25rem;background:var(--gallery);}

components.name: Fabric Canvas

components.css: :host{--ink:#000;--gallery:#fff;--rule:2px;--hatch:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,var(--ink) 0 2px,transparent 2px 5px);--ease-out:cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1);--duration-quick:180ms;font-family:'Schibsted Grotesk',sans-serif;color:var(--ink);background:var(--gallery);} .ds-fabrics{display:flex;gap:0.75rem;} .ds-fabric{display:grid;gap:0.5rem;width:7rem;cursor:pointer;line-height:1.25;} .ds-fabric input{position:absolute;opacity:0;width:1px;height:1px;} .ds-fabric__mount{display:block;padding:7px;} .ds-fabric:hover .ds-fabric__mount{background:repeating-linear-gradient(0deg,var(--ink) 0 1px,transparent 1px 6px);} .ds-fabric input:checked + .ds-fabric__mount{background:repeating-linear-gradient(0deg,var(--ink) 0 2px,transparent 2px 4px);} .ds-fabric input:focus-visible + .ds-fabric__mount{outline:2px solid var(--ink);outline-offset:3px;} .ds-fabric__canvas{display:block;aspect-ratio:1;background:var(--swatch);border:2px solid var(--ink);} .ds-fabric__no{font-size:0.8125rem;letter-spacing:0.1em;text-transform:uppercase;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums lining-nums;} .ds-fabric input:checked ~ .ds-fabric__name{font-weight:700;text-decoration:underline;text-decoration-thickness:2px;text-underline-offset:0.3em;}

narrative.overview:
A white gallery where the interface is drawn in black line fields and the product hangs as the only colour in the room. Every surface of the theme is one of two materials, gallery white and matte ink, and every tone between them is made by how closely ink lines are spaced, never by a grey. The product image is framed like a canvas on a wall of parallel waves; fabric swatches are a row of small numbered canvases; lead time is a set of line strips whose frequency compresses as the piece nears completion.

Density is calm and gallery-like: generous vertical spacing, square frames, 2px ink rules separating every block, and one monumental type moment per page (the product name in tall condensed caps). Ornament is never added on top of the system; hover, selection and progress are all expressed by changing line frequency within the same two colours.

The world refuses the cream-serif furniture page and the photo-left, form-right template. Colour belongs to the merchant's goods, so the interface never competes with it.
keyCharacteristics: Two colours only: gallery white and ink black, both merchant settings.
Tone, emphasis and state made by line frequency (hatching, wave fields, line strips).
2px ink rules and square frames; no radius, no shadow.
Colour appears only in product photography and fabric swatches.
Tall condensed display caps over a neutral grotesk body and small tracked caps for labels.
Motion is a single gesture: the wave field tightens and relaxes while the photo dissolves.

rules.name: The Two Materials Rule
rules.body: The interface uses `--ink` and `--gallery` and nothing else. No greys, no tints, no alpha overlays for tone. If a surface needs to read darker or lighter, change the spacing of ink lines over it.

rules.name: The Product Is The Accent Rule
rules.body: Colour enters the page only through product photography, the 3D model, and fabric swatch images or swatch colours (`--swatch` from the fabric entry). Never colour a button, badge, link or state.

rules.name: The Line Frequency Rule
rules.body: Tone is a frequency: wide spacing reads light, tight spacing reads dark. The shipped vocabulary: wave stage behind the product at 13px spacing (merchant setting, 6 to 24px); footer band at 6px; button and field end-cap hatch at 2px ink every 5px; button hover at 3px ink every 4px (outline variant 1px ink every 5px); swatch hover 1px every 6px, selected 2px every 4px; lead-time strips 2px ink with a gap that shrinks by 2px per stage down to 3px.

rules.name: The One Monument Rule
rules.body: One display-size type moment per page: the product name. Every other display-face use is 2.5rem or smaller.

rules.name: The Numbers Line Up Rule
rules.body: Prices, counts, fabric numbers and dates use tabular lining numerals (`.numerals`).

rules.name: The Frame Not Shadow Rule
rules.body: Separate and lift with a 2px ink frame and a change of line field, never with a shadow or a tint.

dos: **Do** build every new surface from `--ink` and `--gallery` only, and make tone with line spacing.
**Do** use the 2px `--rule` for frames, dividers, borders and focus; keep 1px for drawing detail.
**Do** end buttons and fields with the hatched end cap (2px ink every 5px behind a 2px divider).
**Do** show state by changing line frequency or by inverting to solid ink, never by colour.
**Do** give every swatch a visible number and name, and keep the selected name bold and underlined.
**Do** use the 2px ink outline at 3px offset for every focus state, and keep targets at least 2.5rem (44px for icon links).
**Do** route motion through `--ease-out` with `--duration-quick` (180ms) or `--duration-slow` (700ms), and stop all fields and transitions under `prefers-reduced-motion`.

**Do** keep upgrade blocks self-contained: their own `{% stylesheet %}` and `{% javascript %}`, content from product metafields (`homestage.fabrics`, width/depth/height, lead-time weeks, making stages, sample product, outline drawings).
donts: **Don't** introduce greys, tints, gradients or alpha overlays to make tone.
**Don't** colour any interface element; colour belongs to product photos and swatches.
**Don't** add border radius or box shadows.
**Don't** lay moiré or line fields over product photography; fields sit around the canvas, never on it.
**Don't** set more than one display-size type moment per page.
**Don't** animate prices, or animate anything that hides content without a reduced-motion fallback.
